# SEODXB

> A global SEO agency based in Dubai, specialising in On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Local SEO, and International SEO. We help businesses worldwide get found on Google, cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and every AI-powered search surface.

## What We Do

SEODXB solves the biggest problem most websites face: a lack of organic traffic. We prepare brands for three layers of modern search:

- **On-Page SEO** - Technical audits, keyword strategy, content optimisation, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, and internal linking
- **Technical SEO** - Site speed, crawlability, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and indexation
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)** - Targeting featured snippets, People Also Ask, and voice search to achieve Position Zero
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation)** - Ensuring your brand is cited, recommended, and surfaced by AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude
- **Local SEO** - Google Business Profile, Map Pack rankings, citations, and review management
- **International SEO** - Hreflang, multilingual content, and multi-market strategies

Based in Dubai, UAE. Serving clients across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, UAE, and globally.
